command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== boot id baseline =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
uptime -s

set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== boot id baseline =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
uptime -s

set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "STEP 1: configure /dev/shm hardening via /etc/fstab"
cp -a /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.bak.$(date +%s)
if grep -qE '^\s*tmpfs\s+/dev/shm\s' /etc/fstab; then
  sudo -n sed -i -E 's#^\s*tmpfs\s+/dev/shm\s+tmpfs\s+.*#tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs defaults,nosuid,nodev,noexec,seclabel 0 0#' /etc/fstab
else
  echo 'tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs defaults,nosuid,nodev,noexec,seclabel 0 0' | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab
fi

echo "STEP 2: configure /tmp hardening via systemd tmp.mount drop-in"
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/tmp.mount.d
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/tmp.mount.d/override.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
[Mount]
What=tmpfs
Type=tmpfs
Options=mode=1777,strictatime,nosuid,nodev,noexec
EOF

echo "STEP 3: reload systemd and apply"
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now tmp.mount
sudo -n systemctl restart dev-shm.mount 2>/dev/null || sudo -n mount -o remount /dev/shm

echo "STEP 4: verify live mount options"
findmnt /tmp -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS
findmnt /dev/shm -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS

echo "STEP 5: verify enablement state (must survive reboot)"
systemctl is-enabled tmp.mount
grep -E '/dev/shm' /etc/fstab

echo "STEP 6: functional proof - exec and setuid/device denied"
set +e
echo '#!/bin/sh' > /tmp/exectest.sh
echo 'echo should-not-run' >> /tmp/exectest.sh
chmod +x /tmp/exectest.sh
/tmp/exectest.sh
echo "tmp_exec_rc=$?"

cp /bin/true /dev/shm/shmtest
chmod +x /dev/shm/shmtest
/dev/shm/shmtest
echo "shm_exec_rc=$?"

sudo -n touch /tmp/setuidtest
sudo -n chmod u+s /tmp/setuidtest
ls -l /tmp/setuidtest
stat -c '%A %a' /tmp/setuidtest
set -e
rm -f /tmp/exectest.sh /dev/shm/shmtest
sudo -n rm -f /tmp/setuidtest
echo "DONE"
